## [How to use]{.en}[使用说明]{.zh}

::: {.en}
Each model is a page of sliders. Move any input and the charts and results update at once. Every page works in English and Chinese and loads inside mainland China.

-   **Key inputs or developer.** A switch at the top of each model starts on **Key inputs**: the main sliders across the top, larger charts and one equation under each. Choose **All inputs (developer)** to adjust every assumption and read the full explanations, method and limits. The choice carries across the model pages.
-   **Defaults** come from the [Assumptions register](../appendix/assumptions.qmd), with a source and status for each. CDEG's own figures should replace them first, especially costs per tonne and the meter ex-works price.
-   **All figures are indicative.** They are planning estimates to test, not forecasts.

| Model | Question it answers | Report sections |
|---|---|---|
| [WtE project payback](wte-payback.qmd) (Model 1) | What gate fee, load and licence does a Latrobe Valley plant need to pay its way? | 3.4; Waste-to-energy page |
| [Council price map](council-map.qmd) (Model 3) | Which councils would send waste to a Latrobe site, at what gate fee? | 3.1e; siting |
| [Meter distributor model](meter-distributor.qmd) | How big is the meter market, what do approvals cost, and what profit can CDEG expect? | 3.2; 6.6 |
| [O&M contract model](om-contract.qmd) | What does an O&M contract earn CDEG, and how fast does it repay the entry budget? | 3.2; Table 16 |
:::

::: {.zh}
每个模型都是一个由滑块组成的页面。调整任何参数，图表和结果都会立即更新。所有页面均支持中英文，并可在中国大陆正常访问。

-   **关键参数或开发者模式。** 每个模型顶部的开关默认为**关键参数**：主要滑块排在顶部，图表更大，每张图下方列出一个公式。选择**全部参数（开发者）**可调整所有假设，并查看完整说明、方法和局限。该选择在各模型页面间保持一致。
-   **默认值**来自[假设参数](../appendix/assumptions.qmd)页，每项都注明来源和状态。应首先用集团自己的数据替换，尤其是吨成本和水表出厂价。
-   **所有结果仅供参考。** 它们是有待检验的规划估算，而不是预测。

| 模型 | 回答的问题 | 对应报告章节 |
|---|---|---|
| [垃圾发电项目回收期](wte-payback.qmd)（模型1） | 拉筹伯谷电厂需要多高的处理费、负荷和许可量才能收回投资？ | 3.4；垃圾焚烧发电页 |
| [市政价格地图](council-map.qmd)（模型3） | 在什么处理费下，哪些市政会把垃圾送往拉筹伯谷场址？ | 3.1e；选址 |
| [水表代理模型](meter-distributor.qmd) | 水表市场有多大，认证需要多少费用，集团可以预期多少利润？ | 3.2；6.6 |
| [委托运营模型](om-contract.qmd) | 一份运营合同能为集团带来多少收益，多快能收回进入预算？ | 3.2；表16 |
:::
